jobs.title: Program Manager - AI Agency
jobs.description:
EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. 

Job Description

WHAT DOES A PROGRAM MANAGER - AI AGENCY DO?

EVERSANA's AI Agency is redefining how life sciences brands plan, create, and activate omnichannel marketing. We operate at the intersection of AI-driven content intelligence and precision omnichannel execution - combining the EVERSANA AI Agency Platform (built on Google Cloud, Gemini, and Vertex AI) with the Orchestrate™ Omnichannel Operating System to deliver measurable commercial impact for pharma and biotech brands.

We are a practitioner culture. That means we don't wait for the industry to catch up - we explore, we build, we break things, and we figure out what AI can actually do in a regulated commercial environment before our clients have to ask. If you are the kind of person who has already built your own workflows in tools like Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or Midjourney- who reads the release notes, experiments on weekends, and shows up to client meetings with something real to show - this role was written for you.

The Program Manager is the operational backbone of client engagements within the AI Agency. This is not a traditional project management role - it is a delivery leadership role that owns the execution of complex, multi-workstream client engagements from kickoff through sustained performance. You will serve as the connective tissue between strategy and execution, ensuring that what we promise in a scope of work translates into delivered value on time, on budget, and with measurable client impact.

You will own the day-to-day orchestration of client work - coordinating Strategic Operators, Creative Operators, Activation Directors, and platform teams to deliver unified outcomes. You will translate client objectives and strategic plans into executable project plans, manage resources and timelines, navigate dependencies and blockers, and ensure every engagement operates with clear accountability and predictable delivery rhythms. This role requires someone who can hold the line on scope, anticipate risks before they become problems, and drive teams toward outcomes without losing sight of the bigger strategic picture.

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Project Planning & Execution

Lead project planning for new client engagements - translating statements of work and strategic briefs into detailed project plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Develop and maintain project timelines, workback schedules, and delivery roadmaps that account for client review cycles, regulatory requirements, platform dependencies, and cross-functional coordination needs.
Own the day-to-day execution of client projects - running daily standups, tracking progress against milestones, identifying blockers, and ensuring teams have what they need to deliver on time.
Establish and maintain project governance structures - including status reporting, risk logs, change request protocols, and client communication cadences - that provide transparency and accountability throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Team Coordination

Serve as the central coordination point for cross-functional delivery teams - including Strategic Operators, Creative Operators, Activation Directors, Client Solutions, platform engineering, and external vendor partners.
Facilitate seamless handoffs between strategy, creative, activation, and platform delivery - ensuring work moves efficiently through the pipeline without rework, delays, or misalignment.
Resolve scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, and priority tensions across multiple concurrent projects - balancing client urgency with team capacity and strategic importance.
Partner with functional leads to ensure the right people are staffed to the right work at the right time - advocating for resource adjustments when project needs shift.

Client Communication & Expectation Management

Serve as a client point of contact for project status, timeline updates, and delivery coordination - building trust through consistent communication, proactive transparency, and reliable follow-through.
Lead project meetings, including kickoffs, check-ins, milestone reviews, and retrospectives - ensuring meetings are productive, action-oriented, and move work forward.
Manage expectations around scope, timelines, and deliverables - clearly communicating what's included, what's not, and what trade-offs exist when priorities shift.
Surface and escalate project risks, scope changes, or timeline impacts to Account Directors early - providing clear options and recommendations for path forward.

Scope & Budget Management

Own project-level budget tracking and resource utilization - monitoring hours against budget, identifying variances, and flagging financial risks before they impact account profitability.
Manage scope boundaries vigilantly - identifying scope creep early, documenting out-of-scope requests, and working with Account Directors to convert scope changes into formal change orders.
Track project profitability at the workstream level - understanding where time is being spent, where efficiency can be gained, and where process improvements can improve margin without compromising quality.
Contribute to scoping and estimation for new work - providing input on level of effort, resource requirements, and delivery timelines based on actual project experience.

Process Improvement & Delivery Excellence

Identify patterns, inefficiencies, and friction points in delivery workflows - and build solutions that make the next project run more smoothly than the last.
Contribute to the development of standardized delivery frameworks, project templates, and process documentation that improve consistency and scalability across the AI Agency.
Lead post-project retrospectives with internal teams - capturing lessons learned, celebrating wins, and converting insights into actionable process improvements.
Partner with operations and enablement teams to evolve project management tools, reporting templates, and delivery best practices that support the AI Agency's growth.

Risk Management & Problem Solving

Anticipate project risks before they materialize - including resource constraints, timeline conflicts, dependency gaps, client availability issues, and technical blockers.
Build contingency plans and mitigation strategies for high-risk projects - ensuring backup options exist when things don't go according to plan.
Navigate ambiguity and make decisions under pressure - knowing when to escalate, when to problem-solve independently, and when to bring teams together to find a path forward. Demonstrate
a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
All other duties as assigned

Qualifications

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Experience

7+ years of experience in project management, delivery leadership, or program management within pharma, life sciences, healthcare marketing, or agency environments, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-workstream client engagements on time and on budget.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams in a client delivery environment - including coordinating creative, strategy, technology, and operations teams to deliver unified outcomes.
Working knowledge of pharma commercialization and marketing operations - including brand strategy, omnichannel campaign development, content production workflows, regulatory review processes, and the compliance requirements that govern pharma marketing.
Experience managing project budgets, tracking resource utilization, and operating with P&L accountability - with an understanding of how delivery efficiency impacts account profitability.
Prior experience working in a fast-paced, early-stage, or high-growth environment where processes are still being built and adaptability is required.

Skills & Capabilities

Delivery operator: You know how to take a complex scope of work and break it into executable plans with clear owners, deadlines, and success criteria - and you know how to keep those plans on track without becoming a bottleneck.
Coordination expert: You can orchestrate multiple teams, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously - ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and everyone knows what's expected of them.
Clear communicator: You can run a client meeting with confidence, deliver a difficult message with clarity, and write a status update that tells people what they need to know without wasting their time.
Scope guardian: You know where advisory ends and execution begins, and you hold that line with clients and internal teams - even when it's uncomfortable.
Problem solver under pressure: You don't panic when things go sideways - you assess the situation, build options, make decisions, and keep the team moving forward.
Process builder: You see patterns in chaos and build lightweight systems that make work more predictable, scalable, and repeatable without adding bureaucracy.

Practitioner Mindset - Non-Negotiable

This is a hard filter, not a cultural nicety. EVERSANA AI Agency is a practitioner culture. We expect every member of this team to be an active explorer of AI and marketing technology - not because it's trendy, but because our clients are paying us to know what's possible before they have to ask.

You are actively using AI tools in your daily work right now - not just for writing emails, but to build workflows, test prompts, generate creative, analyze data, and solve problems you haven't been trained to solve yet.
You follow what's happening in the AI and martech space closely enough to have real opinions - about what works, what doesn't, what's overhyped, and what pharma brands should actually pay attention to.
You experiment before you wait for permission. When a new tool drops, you open it. When a client asks 'can AI do X?', you've already tried.
You can credibly demonstrate what AI-generated content, journey logic, or platform automation looks like to a skeptical CMO - not in theory, but with something you've actually built or run.
You are energized by ambiguity and early-stage environments - you know how to operate in a space that is still being defined, and you help define it.
You hold high standards for clarity and push back when a plan isn't ready to execute.
You default to intellectual honesty with clients, even when the honest answer is 'not yet.'
You care about measurable outcomes, not just smooth engagements.

Additional Information

Patient Minded
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight
I own every client experience and its impact on results.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - IT
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda's designated work from home day is currently Tuesday

Business Technology at Lambda builds and scales the internal systems that power our business. We partner across the company with Finance, GTM, Engineering, and People to implement tools, automate workflows, and ensure data flows securely and accurately. Our scope spans enterprise applications, integrations, data platform and analytics, compliance automation, and all things IT.

We are hiring an IT Technical Program Manager to run the programs that make this portfolio move. You will be the first dedicated program management hire in Business Technology, building our portfolio operating model from the ground up: intake, prioritization, delivery cadence, and change management discipline. Business Technology is delivering a business transformation with roughly ten new enterprise systems this year and a growing integration and data footprint. You will drive cross-functional programs from kickoff through go-live and hypercare, and be the connective tissue between our five pillars: Finance Systems, GTM Systems, Data Platform and Analytics, IT Operations, and People Technology.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who runs programs with rigor, communicates crisply to executives, and holds vendors, partners, and internal teams accountable to dates. You will personally carry our largest programs while building the lightweight structures that make every subsequent program faster.

What You'll Do

Program Delivery: Own end-to-end program management for major system implementations across ERP, procurement, EPM, HRIS, treasury, and identity, coordinating internal teams, implementation partners, and vendors from contract signature through cutover, hypercare, and stabilization.
Roadmap Operations: Run the Business Technology roadmap: maintain the portfolio plan, manage a unified intake and prioritization process, surface dependencies and resource conflicts across pillars, and keep the roadmap honest against team capacity.
Portfolio Governance: Stand up lightweight portfolio governance: stage gates proportionate to program risk, RAID and decision logs, and a portfolio health view that gives the COO and CFO real-time visibility across all five pillars.
SOX Program: Serve as the program manager for Business Technology's SOX ITGC readiness workstream: track control design and remediation milestones across in-scope systems (ERP, procurement, EPM, HRIS, identity), coordinate evidence requests with external auditors and advisors, and report readiness status against the design readiness deadline.
Program Cadence: Build and operate the operating rhythm: weekly status, steering committees, executive readouts, and escalation paths that resolve blockers in days.
Change Management: Design and operationalize formal change management for Business Technology systems, including release calendars, freeze windows, and evidence capture that satisfies ITGC requirements. Partner with our SOX and compliance programs so control design milestones are built into program plans rather than bolted on at the end.
Cutover & Go-Live: Drive cutover and go-live planning: UAT tracking, readiness reviews, hypercare exit criteria, and post-launch retrospectives that actually change how the next program runs.
Vendor & Partner Management: Manage implementation partner and vendor delivery: SOW milestones, burn tracking, change orders, and holding partners to committed outcomes.
Executive Communication: Communicate program status to COO, CFO, and Audit Committee audiences with clarity: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what we are doing about it.
AI-Enabled Program Operations: Continuously improve how Business Technology delivers: templates, playbooks, and tooling (Jira, Google Workspace, AI-assisted status collection and reporting) that reduce program overhead and make delivery faster.

You

Experience: 8+ years in technical program management, with at least 4 years running enterprise application or business systems programs (ERP, CRM, HCM, procurement, EPM, or data platform). You have carried at least two large implementations end to end as the program owner, including cutover and hypercare, ideally with a Big 4 or boutique implementation partner on the other side of the table.
Technical Fluency: Fluent enough in systems architecture, integrations, and data flows to challenge a technical plan, spot a hidden dependency, and know when an estimate is wrong.
Compliance & Controls: Have operated in a SOX or audit-facing environment and understand why change management, access controls, and evidence matter to a program plan. Experience working with external auditors is a strong plus.
Operating Rigor: Run a tight operating cadence by default. Your programs have a single source of truth, current RAID logs, and no surprises in steering.
Builder Orientation: Comfortable defining process from zero. You can take a team that runs on tribal knowledge and give it intake, prioritization, and delivery discipline without adding bureaucracy.
Communication: Communicate exceptionally well upward and sideways. You can compress a messy multi-workstream program into one slide a CFO trusts.
Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and velocity. Priorities shift at a pre-IPO company, and you re-plan without drama.
Attitude: An enthusiastic, go-for-it attitude. When you see a program drifting, you can't help but grab it.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with our stack: NetSuite, Salesforce, Coupa, Workday, Pigment, Workato, Okta, Lumos, BigQuery.
Pre-IPO or IPO readiness program experience, including ITGC remediation or Audit Committee reporting.
Experience with enterprise AI governance: tool approval workflows, AI inventory management, or build-vs-buy frameworks for AI-native applications.
Experience using AI tooling to automate status collection, reporting, and program hygiene.
PMP, PgMP, or SAFe credentials (useful, not required; judgment beats certification).

jobs.title: Project Manager III
jobs.description:
PBG delivers mission-focused solutions that eliminate inefficiency and power transformation for federal agencies requiring agility, security, and impact.

The Opportunity:
The Aerospace Capabilities Portfolio Office (ACPO) runs ongoing software, data, and machine learning development supporting its applications and its broader data community. This work moves quickly: AI-accelerated development shortens delivery cycles and, in turn, increases the planning, coordination, and reporting burden placed on project management. ACPO needs a seasoned, data-forward Scrum Master who can absorb that burden, keep fast-moving teams aligned and unblocked, and turn strategy, priorities, and available team capacity into predictable day-to-day execution. This person uses delivery data to measure and continuously improve how the team performs, sets and enforces the standards the team works to, and coaches and pushes the team to meet them. This is a hands-on delivery role working directly with project leads and leadership, and its purpose is to make delivery run smoothly enough that leadership can rely on it.

Responsibilities:

Facilitate agile delivery end to end: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement, keeping each ceremony focused and time-boxed.
Work with project leads to translate strategy, priorities, and team resources into executable sprint and release plans, and keep day-to-day execution aligned to those priorities.
Remove impediments, coordinate cross-team and external dependencies, and protect the team’s focus so it can deliver consistently.
Produce clear delivery products and overviews (roadmaps, prioritization and trade-off views, delivery and status reporting) that let leadership make informed trade decisions on prioritization and investment.
Use delivery data to drive efficiency: track metrics (velocity, throughput, burn-down, cycle time, defect rate, and delivery-performance metrics), find where the team loses time or quality, and act on it to measurably improve how the team performs.
Establish the delivery and quality standards the team works to, document them, and hold the team accountable to them.
Adapt agile practice to an AI-accelerated pace: streamline planning and coordination so process keeps up with faster development cycles rather than slowing them down.
Manage the backlog with product owners and project leads, ensuring upcoming work is refined, estimated, and aligned to stakeholder needs.
Coach and push the team: raise the team’s agile discipline, hold people to commitments and standards, and foster a collaborative, high-performing delivery environment.

Qualifications:

Required:

10+ years of experience in agile delivery, Scrum Master, or agile project/program management roles.
Active Scrum Master certification (e.g., PSM, CSM, or SAFe Scrum Master).
Deep, demonstrated command of Scrum and other agile frameworks (Kanban, SAFe, Lean), and of servant-leadership practice.
Demonstrated experience translating strategy and priorities into executable team plans and keeping delivery aligned to them.
Demonstrated experience producing delivery metrics, status products, and reporting that support leadership decision-making and prioritization.
Demonstrated use of delivery data and metrics to measurably improve team efficiency and quality (for example, reducing cycle time or defect rates).
Demonstrated experience setting delivery or quality standards and holding a team accountable to them, and coaching teams to a higher level of performance.
Proficiency with agile delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar).

Desired:

Experience facilitating teams that build software, data, and applied AI/ML products.
Experience adapting agile process to fast-moving, AI-driven development.
Experience coaching or mentoring other Scrum Masters, or scaling agile across multiple teams.
Familiarity with software delivery-performance metrics, for example the DORA (DevOps Research and Assessment) metrics, and building dashboards that give leadership visibility into delivery.
Experience coordinating across multiple stakeholders and programs simultaneously

jobs.title: Technology Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At MetLife, data isn’t just a tool – it is a catalyst for growth. As part of our Data & Analytics organization, you’ll unlock trusted insights that drive bold decisions, power personalized customer experiences, and deliver lasting business impact. We’re building the future of data – one that’s governed responsibly, engineered for scalability, and designed for growth. When you join us, you’re not just supporting the business – you’re empowering it. Let’s transform insight into impact and data into action, together.

The Opportunity

The MetLife Corporate Functions Data Office, part of the Data & Analytics Organization (D&A) within GTO, is responsible for delivering scalable data solutions that enable actionable insights and business outcomes. As part of MetLife's Reinsurance Modernization and FAIRR Data Hub initiatives, we partner with D&A teams, Technology, and Business stakeholders to design and deploy next-generation data platforms and capabilities that support MetLife's New Frontier strategy.

We are seeking a Data Analyst who is passionate about data and understands its end-to-end lifecycle. This role will play a key part in enabling data-driven transformation across Reinsurance, Actuarial, Finance, and Corporate Functions, supporting the development of trusted data products, analytics solutions, and modern reporting capabilities. The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen with hands-on technical expertise in analytics, SQL, Big Data, and Cloud technologies.

The successful candidate will contribute to the FAIRR Data Hub ecosystem by helping establish a single source of truth for reinsurance data domains, including treaty, premium, claims, recoverables, financial, and operational data. This role will support data onboarding, profiling, quality assessment, reconciliation, governance, and business analytics initiatives that drive operational excellence, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with business and functional analysts to develop functional and technical requirements documents for production-grade data and analytics solutions that drive MetLife’s business forward.
Support Reinsurance Modernization and FAIRR Data Hub initiatives through data analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.
Partner with Reinsurance, Actuarial, Finance, Operations, Technology, and D&A teams to define and deliver scalable data and analytics solutions.
Analyze end-to-end reinsurance processes and develop business requirements, data mappings, process flows, and source-to-target technical specifications.
Collaborate with Data Architecture, Engineering, Governance, Modeling, Quality, and Data Science teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
Understand and Analyze end to end business processes and deliver detailed data flow diagrams.
Facilitate the interaction between the business and technical teams to ensure requirements are understood and solutions meet the requirements.
Support onboarding of treaty, premium, claims, recoverables, and financial data into the FAIRR Data Hub, ensuring data quality, governance, and traceability.
Validate and test solutions to ensure alignment with business requirements and expected outcomes.
Lead complex data analysis efforts, facilitate stakeholder discussions, and provide recommendations on data solutions and implementation approaches.
Mentor junior analysts, review deliverables, and promote best practices in data analysis and solutioning.
Contribute to AI-enabled analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision-making across the reinsurance value chain.

Required Qualifications

5 – 7+ years of relevant experience in data analysis.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent educational qualification.
Excellent communication and structured problem-solving skills: demonstrated ability to document and explain complex system flows to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in partner and stakeholder engagement.
Technical proficiency in data profiling, data validation, and data storage/retrieval principles for Azure, document databases, and relational databases.
Understanding of data warehouses, data marts, data lakes, and Medallion architecture.
Domain-based design, solutioning, and estimation experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.
Technical proficiency in SQL/NOSQL, Python
Experience in financial or insurance settings.
Experience with Databricks, serverless SQL, Data Governance, and Data Quality.
Appetite to learn new technologies and innovate.
Hands on AI experience.
Experience working in Agile environments and with cloud platforms.
Certification in relevant tools or platforms is a plus.

Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role r equiring a minimum of 3 days per week
in office.

The expected salary range for this position is $90 ,000 - $118,000 . This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.

Benefits We Offer

Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here.

About MetLife

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs

Compensation:
(US Pay Range: $88,277 - $103,222/yr; UK Pay Range: £49,598 - £60,040/yr) Posted pay ranges apply to US-based candidates. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the Role

The Project Manager provides consulting services for our multi-use facility client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. Projects consist of both ground up and facility infrastructure construction projects. Role may require up to 50% travel regionally predominantly in the Eastern Time Zone.

What You’ll Do

Manage all areas of project management for singular real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.

Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.

Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE (Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence) values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.

Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within own team and other related teams.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Senior Project Manager

Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the overall management and administration of client projects throughout the entire project lifecycle. The Senior Project Manager is at the core of the team and helps everyone to communicate clearly while staying on time, on budget, and meets the highest of quality standards. This individual must demonstrate solid business judgment and sound strategic thinking. This role reports to the Director of Project Management.

Responsibilities: 

Understands the scope of work across an assigned account, as well as the project plan at an individual project level
Facilitates interdepartmental negotiation process to reach alignment on project resources and timelines
Aligns with Department Resource Managers to assign resources and ensure effective time management throughout a project life cycle
Continually monitors projects to ensure deliverables are on schedule and within scope
Collaborates with Account team to obtain client sign-off on project plans when needed
Prepares for all legal and regulatory submissions
Works closely with department leads on forecasting and future resource planning on assigned accounts
Builds partnerships and is persuasive/diplomatic in difficult situations
Ensures client requests are captured, executed, and exceed expectation
Partners with project stakeholders to ensure quality assurance standards and best practices are in place
Responsible for raising and maintaining awareness of all project issues and risks, and works with appropriate stakeholders to develop solutions
Expert in managing a high volume of work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment
Acts as an internal hub of project information for assigned accounts
Maintains a proficient level of brand(s) knowledge

Qualifications

Proven track record of success in a fast-paced environment with the ability to quickly learn new technology
4+ years of project management experience, in pharmaceutical advertising or medical education
Expertise of project management techniques with a proven experience in people management, strategic planning, risk mitigation, hours and reporting
Ability to lead and manage multiple projects and project coordinators
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Ability to “think on your feet” and resolve issues quickly with little to no direction from supervisors; makes good judgments and renders solid decisions
Experience with the pharmaceutical business medical-legal regulations process preferred
Familiarity and proficiency with the principles of emotional intelligence
Excellent administrative and computer skills, with proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and knowledge of basic project management software

S
alary Range:

Role Overview

Nscale is scaling AI infrastructure across the United States, and the energy that powers it is now the company’s largest sustainability lever and one of its biggest commercial differentiators. The Senior Manager, & Carbon-Free Energy will own the roadmap for sourcing carbon-free energy (CFE) across Nscale’s U.S. portfolio and lead its core environmental strategy.

The role pairs two mandates. First, find, evaluate and help close the energy deals that decarbonize Nscale’s load: PPAs, virtual PPAs, utility green tariffs, energy attribute certificates and emerging firm clean sources such as advanced nuclear, geothermal and storage-backed renewables. Second, lead strategy on water, embodied carbon and the emissions Nscale produces from its own operations.

The role partners closely with Power/Utility, Site Development, Finance, Legal and Commercial teams, carries direct people-leadership responsibility and is designed to scale as Nscale grows.

Key Responsibilities

Carbon-Free Energy Strategy & Procurement
Own Nscale’s carbon-free energy (CFE) strategy and roadmap, setting portfolio targets by U.S. market and site type
Partner with Power/Utility and Commercial teams to originate, structure, negotiate and close clean energy transactions, including physical and virtual PPAs, utility green tariffs and sleeved supply, and renewable energy certificates (RECs).
Build business cases including financial models for price, basis, shape and volume risk, contract tenor, and credit and collateral requirements.
Run energy due diligence during site selection: grid carbon intensity, local CFE supply, utility and market structure, interconnection timelines, and regulatory barriers to clean supply.
Represent Nscale with utilities, independent power producers, developers, brokers and regulators; build a pipeline of offtake opportunities in each U.S. market where Nscale operates.

Emerging & Firm Clean Energy Sources

spacecraft GNC systems and flight software (FSW). Ten One Aerospace is developing a full
suite of GNC capabilities for space missions, including RPO and docking across all orbital
regimes.

Spacecraft RPO is a challenging, highly specialized, multidisciplinary field of aerospace
engineering, extending beyond traditional GNC, and it is critical to space missions such as debris
removal, on-orbit servicing, refueling, and in-space manufacturing. At Ten One Aerospace, we
aim to make RPO safe and affordable to lower the entry barriers for new space companies and
enable a robust space economy.

When you join Ten One Aerospace, you’ll be a vital part of a passionate and supportive team
dedicated to pushing the frontiers of aerospace technology. You’ll be empowered and given
autonomy to propose improvements or innovations based on your observations and expertise.

Our culture thrives on mentorship and intellectual growth as we seek to build a team of world-
class experts on this critical skill set of spacefaring tomorrow.

Ten One Aerospace is seeking a Senior Program Manager who is excited to apply their
experience to customer-facing projects at an innovative space company. As a Senior PM you will
have responsibility, accountability, and authority to plan and execute projects that develop and
deliver Ten One’s Rendezvous Proximity Operations (RPO) Kits and other Guidance,
Navigation, and Control (GNC) capabilities to our customers. You will provide coordination and
leadership to cross-functional internal teams, external suppliers, and subcontractors. You will
own all aspects of your projects and be the TOA focal responsible for ensuring customer
satisfaction aligned with the scope of firm fixed price and time & materials contracts.

assembly, integration, testing and delivery, including both hardware and software.
Negotiate realistic program schedules and budgets, and continually track to on-time and

on-cost program execution.
Coordinate with internal teams such as systems engineering, GNC, flight software,

hardware, finance, contracts, and the project management office (PMO) to ensure
successful cross-functional program execution.
Lead efforts to identify and manage subcontractors, consultants, and vendors to support

your programs.
Build strong working relationships with customer teams and collaboratively work to

define and execute well-structured firm fixed price and time & materials contracts.
Continuously monitor and mitigate scope creep.
Contribute to project management and PMO process improvement efforts, focusing on

right-sized efficiency and building a strong foundation to support company growth.
Mentor junior team members in areas such as project management best practices and

effective communication practices.

Required Qualifications

10+ years managing technical projects and programs, preferably in the aerospace

industry, and at least partially at small companies or startups.
Bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field (aerospace, software, systems,

mechanical, or other engineering).

Experience managing costs on firm fixed price contracts using tools such as EVM.
Experience with formal risk and opportunity management processes.

new_jobs.title: Software Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing.

Efficient Computer is building the next generation of super-efficient, general-purpose processors around the Fabric architecture, a novel spatial dataflow design. The Fabric is only as useful as the software that targets it: the effcc compiler, the system software stack (optimization libraries such as eff-dsp and, over time, the runtime), and the SDK that customers build on.

We are looking for a Software Technical Program Manager to own the quarterly release of this software, from scoping and commitment through code freeze, qualification, and ship. You will be the operational center of the software program: building and defending the release plan, driving the critical path, holding the quality bar, and making tradeoff conversations happen before something slips. You will work daily with the compiler, system software, embedded, and product teams, and regularly interface with architecture and hardware teams especially when it comes time to bring-up new silicon.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Release

Own the execution of the quarterly software release from planning through ship: the schedule, critical path, and delivery. Product defines what ships and why, Engineering determines what is feasible, and you are accountable for when and how it lands. Each release bundles the SDK, the effcc compiler, optimized software libraries, and eventually the runtime.
Build the release plan with product managers, team leads, and engineering managers. This includes feature commitments, freeze dates, qualification windows, and ship criteria, informed by Product's customer requirements and the hardware schedule.
Drive the weekly execution cadence (release reviews, bug triage, go/no-go) and maintain a single source of truth for status, dependencies, and decisions.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Coordinate handoffs across the compiler, system software, and embedded teams, and with architecture, product and hardware teams.
Keep Product Management informed about execution and raise risks accordingly that could affect the release schedule, quality, or feature-set.
Manage the release's dependency chains: e.g. compiler features that libraries depend on, interfaces shared between the SDK and the runtime, LLVM and toolchain versions, board and silicon availability, etc.

Maintain Release Quality

Establish with our teams release quality gates: e.g. no regressions in cycles, energy, or code size on the benchmark suites relative to the previous release; test coverage thresholds met, etc.

Run the release checklist (the gates above plus documentation, release notes, etc.), working with the release shepherd to hold owners to closure criteria.

Track escaped defects and feed what we learn back into the checklist.

Manage Risk, Decisions, and Reporting

Surface risk early with mitigation options and schedule impact quantified: e.g. late compiler features, coverage shortfalls, and benchmark regressions.
Facilitate scope, schedule, and quality tradeoffs, and document what was decided, by whom, and why.
Deliver executive reporting: where the release stands, what is at risk, what decision is needed and by when.

Required Qualifications

B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. or MBA a plus.
7+ years in software engineering or program management, including prior hands-on engineering experience in compilers, systems software, or embedded software.
Working fluency in using AI-tools to facilitate program management – from reporting, to issue tracking, to dependency analysis and more.
Strong experience with the software delivery flow: compiler toolchains, embedded SDKs, CI/CD, test coverage, performance benchmarking, and release engineering.
Demonstrated ability to build and defend a bottoms-up schedule with critical path analysis and dependency mapping.
Track record influencing without authority: earning the technical credibility to push senior engineers on commitments and dates.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to run a room of principal engineers and an executive review with equal effectiveness.
Hands-on with program tooling: Github, Linear, Jira, Notion, Confluence, CI systems, etc.

Desired Qualifications & Experience Requirements

Experience as the technical program manager on a first-generation silicon product, where the toolchain and hardware matured together.
Familiarity with LLVM or MLIR, machine learning compilers, or language runtimes.
Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures.
Experience managing pre-silicon software enablement against emulation or FPGA prototyping programs.

We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $200,000 to $260,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate.

Why Join Efficient?

Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technology Integration & Support is responsible for the end-to-end onboarding, integration, and deployment of automation vendor technologies (AGVs, AMRs, autonomous floor care, etc.) across Amazon's fulfillment and sortation network. This role serves as the primary technical liaison between external vendors and internal Amazon stakeholders — ensuring that all vendor technologies meet Amazon's network, security, and compliance standards before deployment.

Key job responsibilities

Vendor Technology Onboarding (40%)

Own the full lifecycle of vendor IT onboarding for AGV/AMR and automation technologies — from initial kick-off through production deployment
Conduct technical kick-off meetings with vendor engineering teams to review Amazon IT requirements (network architecture, security, IoT device standards)
Guide vendors through Amazon's onboarding documentation process: network diagrams, IT overview questionnaires, data element inventories, and wireless device assessment forms
Manage 4–5 concurrent vendor onboarding projects at steady state; scale to 10+ during peak periods
Track onboarding status across all active vendors using Asana and/or SmartSheet dashboards

Network Architecture & Configuration (20%)

Review and approve vendor network diagrams for compliance with Amazon network standards
Configure VLANs, assign static IPs, generate PPSKs (pre-shared keys) for WiFi 802.11ax connectivity
Coordinate ACL port configurations and firewall rule deployments with local IT and network engineering teams
Validate that vendor IoT devices operate within approved frequency bands, protocols, and power levels

Security & Compliance (15%)

Manage Third-Party Security (TPS) assessments with Amazon InfoSec — submit tickets, gather vendor responses, track remediation
Author and submit ANOW (Access Network Operations Workflow) requests for vendor network access
Coordinate IoT device certification through Amazon's hardware qualification pipeline
Ensure vendor technologies meet mTLS, SSO, and SiteConnect/VPN requirements before go-live

Technical Assessments & Documentation (10%)

Author formal Vendor Technical Assessment reports evaluating integration risk, network impact, and deployment readiness
Document conditional approvals, pilot constraints, and scaling requirements for each technology
Maintain a centralized knowledge base of approved devices, network configurations, and onboarding playbooks

Infrastructure Deployment Coordination (10%)

Coordinate physical infrastructure work with general contractors (GCs) — network rack installation, LVC/power cabling, IPC housing, fire alarm panel integration
Develop and distribute BOMs (Bills of Materials) for site-level technology deployments
Establish and run weekly coordination meetings for multi-site rollouts

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management (5%)

Serve as the single-threaded owner for vendor IT integration across legal, category management, IT security, safety, demand intake, and local IT teams
Manage escalations from site teams, EU/international stakeholders, and Amazon leadership
Provide regular status updates to program leadership on vendor onboarding pipeline health

A day in the life

A Day in the Life

Every Day As a Technical Program Manager On The Technology Integration & Support Team Brings a Dynamic Mix Of Technical Problem-solving, Vendor Collaboration, And Cross-functional Coordination. Here’s What a Typical Day Looks Like

You start your morning by reviewing your Asana and Taskei dashboards to check the status of 4–5 active vendor onboarding projects. You flag any blockers — maybe a vendor’s network diagram needs revisions before it can be approved, or a Third-Party Security (TPS) assessment is awaiting InfoSec feedback. You prioritize your day around what will keep these projects moving forward.

By mid-morning, you’re leading a technical kick-off call with a new AGV vendor’s engineering team. You walk them through Amazon’s IT requirements — network standards, security protocols, IoT device certification — and outline the onboarding documentation they’ll need to complete. You answer their questions about VLAN configurations, WiFi 802.11ax connectivity, and mTLS requirements, translating Amazon’s standards into actionable steps for the vendor.

After lunch, you shift into hands-on technical work. You review a vendor’s submitted network diagram for compliance, configure VLAN assignments and static IPs for an upcoming pilot site, and generate PPSKs for wireless device connectivity. You coordinate with the local IT team on ACL port configurations and firewall rules that need to be deployed before the vendor’s equipment arrives on-site.

In the afternoon, you join a weekly coordination meeting for a multi-site robotics rollout. You provide updates on the technology integration workstream, review the Bill of Materials for the next site, and align with general contractors on network rack installation timelines. After the meeting, you draft a Vendor Technical Assessment report evaluating a new automation technology’s integration risk, network impact, and deployment readiness.

Throughout the day, you’re the single-threaded owner connecting the dots between vendors, site teams, IT security, legal, and program leadership. You might field an escalation from a European site team about a connectivity issue, submit an ANOW request for vendor network access, or update leadership on the health of your vendor onboarding pipeline. No two days are exactly the same, but every day centers on making sure the right technology gets integrated safely, securely, and on schedule.

About The Team

The GESA Development Engineering Automation Team is here to help provide Automated Solutions for projects ranging from AGV Tugger Systems and Floor Cleaning AMRs to Automated Turret Trucks and beyond. Our team is responsible for standardizing and qualifying Automated Vehicle Systems for use within Amazon Facilities, both retrofitted Automation Packages as well as Green Field Designs for future Facility Generations.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of technical program management experience
2+ years of work in large-scale networking environments experience
Knowledge of project management tools and software
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Management, Information Systems, or other related discipline

Experience managing external vendor relationships in a technical capacity

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in quality assurance/testing/mobile industry/internet of things (IoT)
Experience in one or more of the following: application security frameworks, security code reviews, incident response, security infrastructure, penetration testing, mobile security, cloud security, AI security, identity and access controls
Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
Knowledge of operating systems, hardware, storage, network, security, database administration and cloud infrastructure
Experience working in fulfillment center, warehouse, or industrial automation environments

Founded by industry veterans with a surging book of business, we are assembling an in-house  technology team to join the Founding Trio in Woodland Hills, CA to accelerate our growth:

Collaborating directly alongside our founders, this team will oversee the platform build and manage client rollout cycles while rapidly scaling our core e-commerce platform. 

The Role: Technical Implementation Manager (Founding)
Location:
 Woodland Hills, CA (Hybrid / On-site with Founders)
Compensation:
 $95,000 - $115,000 + Equity

You own Guidant's client implementation function: getting cemeteries live on the platform, on-brand, and actually using it to run their business. You bridge senior leadership, engineering, and client technical teams during onboarding. You are technical enough to do hands-on branding and connector work, and you feed clear product feedback to engineering. Engineering owns what becomes permanent in the platform. This is not a software engineering seat and not a product owner seat.

Implementation Portfolio Leadership

●      Direct the building of a scalable system for getting clients live on our e-commerce platform
●      Own a concurrent implementation portfolio with clear sequencing and go-live targets
●      Set playbooks, cadence, and visibility for founders and engineering across rollouts

Program and Project Management

Client Implementation

●      Configure and launch client experiences faster (using AI where appropriate)
●      Cover site setup, content migration, and day-to-day implementation tasks
●      Move without waiting on engineering for every change

Connectors and Integrations

●      Stand up and maintain connectors each cemetery or mortuary needs to operate
●      Work APIs, webhooks, CMS, and related handoffs with client technical teams

Safe Prototyping and Client Extensions

●      Prefer configurations and extensions that survive platform upgrades
●      Avoid approaches that break when the shared codebase ships
●      Hand lasting product gaps to engineering as clear feature requests; engineering owns what becomes permanent

Description

Northland Controls is seeking an experienced Embedded Program Manager in Sunnyvale, CA. This is an exciting opportunity for a proven security industry professional who enjoys working closely with enterprise customers, leading global service programs, developing high-performing teams, and continuously improving service delivery.

In this role, you will be embedded within a key enterprise customer account, serving as a trusted program partner and primary point of coordination between the customer and Northland Controls. You will lead a multidisciplinary embedded team that may include Project Managers, consultants, systems technicians, and engineers, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with program requirements and customer priorities.

You will maintain regular touch points with the global team, review and verify work, provide monthly program updates, partner with customer leadership on challenges and opportunities, and lead quarterly business reviews focused on KPIs, SLAs, priorities, and continuous improvement. You will also be accountable for the performance and development of each team member and for making resource or team adjustments when delivery expectations are not being met.

If you're looking for an opportunity to become deeply integrated with a global customer program, strengthen service delivery, develop talented teams, and make a measurable impact in a growing organization, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Serve as the embedded program leader within a key enterprise customer account, developing a strong understanding of the customer's organization, security program, priorities, standards, operating model, and long-term objectives.
Maintain daily or regular touch points with the global embedded team to review priorities, verify work, remove blockers, and ensure services are being delivered in accordance with program requirements.
Act as the primary point of contact between the customer and Northland Controls for program-level planning, performance, communication, escalation, and issue resolution.
Partner closely with customer management on strategic focus areas, active projects, delivery improvements, program challenges, opportunities, and the ongoing evolution of the program.
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team that may include Project Managers, consultants, systems technicians, and engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing work environment.
Establish clear expectations for each team member and hold individuals accountable for performance, service quality, responsiveness, and delivery commitments.
Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, mentorship, and direction; manage performance improvement and corrective action in accordance with Northland processes, and recommend team adjustments when sustained improvement is not achieved.
Allocate and prioritize resources across projects, operational needs, and customer initiatives while balancing workloads and optimizing utilization, productivity, and coverage.
Track program performance using KPIs, SLAs, delivery milestones, workload data, and other relevant metrics; identify trends and take action when performance is at risk.
Prepare and deliver regular program updates to customer stakeholders and Northland leadership, including performance, resource, financial, risk, and improvement reporting.
Lead the development and presentation of Quarterly Business Reviews, coordinating team inputs, reporting against KPIs and SLAs, collecting customer feedback, aligning on quarterly priorities, and driving follow-through on agreed actions.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, proactively managing expectations, addressing concerns, and supporting strong satisfaction and confidence in the team's services.
Track and analyze relationship and service indicators, including stakeholder feedback, responsiveness, recurring concerns, and service-quality trends, to assess the effectiveness of program delivery and relationship management.
Identify program risks, dependencies, and issues; develop mitigation plans and work with customer management and Northland leadership to proactively address challenges and keep delivery on track.
Manage the overall embedded team budget, monitor expenditures and forecasts, identify budget risks, and provide monthly financial and accrual reporting as required.
Conduct regular quality reviews of team outputs and service delivery to ensure work aligns with customer requirements, established standards, and program expectations.
Drive continuous improvement by analyzing scheduling, workload, performance, and service data to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve delivery processes and outcomes.
Coordinate across internal teams, customer stakeholders, program peers, suppliers, and dependency partners to align delivery, share best practices, and ensure seamless integration of work across the program.
Gather and analyze feedback from customer stakeholders and team members and translate that feedback into practical improvements to services, processes, team performance, and working relationships.
Proactively identify and resolve conflicts, facilitating practical solutions and timely escalation when issues require additional leadership involvement.
Conduct periodic program evaluations and lessons-learned reviews to assess outcomes, document improvements, and inform future program planning and service strategy.
Travel to customer locations and team sites as required.

What We're Looking For

Significant experience managing complex enterprise programs, embedded services, or technical service-delivery teams within the security industry or a closely related technical environment.
Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers and managing long-term customer relationships in a high-visibility, service-oriented environment.
Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams, including direct accountability for individual performance and service delivery.
Strong experience with KPI and SLA management, executive-level program reporting, Quarterly Business Reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of program financial management, budgeting, forecasting, accrual reporting, resource planning, workload balancing, and cost controls.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, dependencies, and competing requirements within a large global customer environment.
Strong knowledge of physical security systems and services, including access control, video surveillance, and related enterprise technologies.
Experience with Lenel, Software House, or similar enterprise security platforms; relevant certifications are highly desirable.
PMP certification or equivalent program or project management credentials preferred.
Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, anticipate risks, navigate changing priorities, and drive issues through resolution.
Ability to build productive, trusted relationships with customers, colleagues, suppliers, and business partners while operating effectively as both a customer-facing partner and a representative of Northland Controls.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel as required.

Why Join Northland Controls?

At Northland Controls, you'll have the opportunity to become an integral part of a key enterprise customer's global security program while leading the people, processes, and performance that support consistent service delivery. You'll work alongside experienced customer, project, engineering, and operations professionals while helping strengthen the teams and operating practices that support our continued growth.

We value innovation, accountability, collaboration, and doing what it takes to deliver exceptional results for our customers. As an Embedded Program Manager, you'll have the opportunity to build lasting customer partnerships, develop your team, improve how services are delivered, and make a meaningful impact across the organization.

Northland Controls offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health and retirement benefits, professional development opportunities, and a flexible working environment.

With nearly 60 years of experience, ADGA supports federal clients and Canada’s intelligence and enforcement agencies through embedded teams, advisory services, and full project execution, applying deep operational expertise and innovation to strengthen national safety, resilience, and sovereignty. Guided by a strong social mandate, the company creates meaningful employment for veterans of the CAF and RCMP and other professionals committed to public service, while fostering a safe, inclusive, and agile workplace that supports career development, professional growth, and impactful work across Canada.

ADGA is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support complex projects involving integrated technologies and systems.

The successful candidate will manage an assigned portfolio of projects throughout the full project lifecycle, including planning, initiation, options analysis, implementation, and in-service support. The Project Manager will ensure projects are delivered within established time, cost, performance, quality, and risk parameters.

This role requires a strong project management professional with demonstrated experience managing complex technical projects involving hardware integration, software integration, software development, and/or systems engineering. The successful candidate will work closely with project teams and stakeholders to define requirements, manage risks, support procurement activities, and provide clear and actionable reporting on project progress.

Manage an assigned portfolio of projects throughout the planning, initiation, options analysis, implementation, and in-service support phases.
Ensure projects are delivered within established scope, schedule, budget, performance, quality, and risk parameters.
Formulate problem statements and requirements and establish procedures for the development and implementation of new or modified project elements.

Schedule

Risk
Resources

A minimum of 24 months of demonstrated experience within the past 60 months supporting projects involving at least three of the following: Hardware integration
Software integration

Systems engineering

Risk management

Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Must currently hold or be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret Secret (Level III) Canadian Federal Government Security clearance, VCR’s and Controlled Goods clearances. If you require accommodations during any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We are happy to work with you to meet your needs.

used to screen, evaluate, or make decisions about applicants for this role.

*Unless otherwise stated, all job postings reflect a current vacancy at the time of publication.
