Role Definition

Responsible for transforming data from across Gamechanger Farming into clear, accurate and practical insight, with particular ownership of recurring reporting, customer data submissions, dashboards and data quality. The role combines hands-on analysis with confident ownership of reporting, stakeholder relationships and the ongoing development of data processes.

Key Responsibilities

Dashboards, Reporting and Insight

Design, build, maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards and other business intelligence solutions.
Own recurring reporting and analysis, ensuring outputs are accurate, clear and delivered within agreed deadlines.
Turn operational and commercial questions into practical analysis covering livestock movements, animal health and mortality, forecasting, planning, finance and KPIs.
Create user-friendly and, where appropriate, self-service reporting that reduces reliance on recurring spreadsheets and manual data requests.
Identify trends, risks and opportunities and explain the key message and business context to technical and non-technical audiences.

Customer Reporting and Stakeholder Management

Act as a confident point of contact for data and reporting across Gamechanger, building and maintaining strong relationships with internal teams, customers and external partners.
Manage routine work alongside ad hoc requests, reprioritising where needed according to customer need, business impact, urgency and deadlines.
Keep stakeholders informed of progress and communicate early where priorities change or a deadline may be at risk.
Respond confidently to stakeholder questions and follow actions or data queries through to completion.

Ownership, Planning and Delivery

As the dedicated Data Analyst within Gamechanger, take clear ownership of the data and reporting workload and drive agreed actions through from start to finish.
Work independently and proactively, maintaining clear visibility of progress and completing agreed follow-ups from meetings and calls.
Raise risks, delays or data issues early and involve the right people where support is needed.

Data Quality, Controls and Documentation

Collect, clean, reconcile, validate and analyse data from farms, internal systems and external sources.
Complete sense checks before information is issued externally and investigate errors, gaps and unusual results through to resolution.
Maintain clear documentation of dashboards, reports, data sources, assumptions, controls and recurring submission processes.
Protect the integrity of master data and support consistent definitions, coding and linking across systems.
Ensure data outputs are reproducible, appropriately controlled and not dependent on undocumented individual knowledge.

Systems, App and Continuous Improvement

Use Power BI, Excel, SSRS and SQL to analyse data, improve reporting and help investigate data or system issues.
Work with colleagues across the business, including the ABP Data Team, to improve reporting, data processes and automation.
Support the ongoing development and automation of the Gamechanger App, contributing ideas, testing changes and helping shape how it works for the business.
As the App becomes established, build the knowledge needed to support it day to day, carry out initial investigation of routine issues and work with the ABP Data Team or relevant specialist where technical changes are required.

PERSONAL SPECIFICATION

Demonstrable experience designing and building Power BI dashboards or equivalent business intelligence solutions.
Good working knowledge of SQL, strong Excel skills and experience analysing data, including using SQL to help investigate data or App issues.
Confidence working independently as the dedicated Data Analyst within Gamechanger, while collaborating effectively with the ABP Data Team and wider business.
Excellent planning and organisational skills, with a proven ability to manage competing priorities and strict deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management and customer service skills, including confidence communicating with external partners.
High attention to detail and a disciplined approach to checking, validating and documenting work.
Strong sense of ownership, a proactive approach and the confidence to make decisions, manage priorities and raise risks early when support is needed.
Naturally curious and improvement-focused, with practical problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge inefficient processes.
Experience working with data in an agriculture or finance environment is desirable.
A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science or a related subject is preferred, although relevant practical experience will be considered.

next, across the full customer journey.

In this role, you’ll connect the dots between data, performance, and decision-making, transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for marketing and commercial teams. You’ll build trusted

dashboards, define measurement standards, and help create a consistent, data-driven approach across channels and business units.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys both the technical and strategic side of analytics, ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and ultimately used to optimize campaigns, improve performance, and drive

measurable growth.

Drives actionable insights for optimization to channel managers.
Supports end-to-end marketing performance measurement across channels and funnel stages, including reach, engagement, leads, pipeline, revenue, and ROI.
Builds and maintains executive-ready dashboards and scorecards with consistent KPI definitions, filters, and drill paths.
Establishes and maintains measurement frameworks, including KPI dictionaries, data sources, calculation logic, reporting cadence, and benchmarks.
Partners with multi-channel marketing teams to support lead lifecycle tracking, source attribution, and influence reporting.
Owns measurement-readiness standards, including UTM governance, tagging requirements, event tracking, and QA checklists.

5+ years of experience developing KPI strategies, measurement methodologies, and performance reporting.
5+ years of advanced experience with reporting and data visualization tools, including Power BI, Google Analytics 4, and Adobe Analytics required.

Degree concentration in Analytics, Statistics, Marketing Analytics, Business, Data Science, or related field.

Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

HYBRID:
Qualified candidates (in or near hub locations listed below) should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment.

HUB LOCATIONS:
Richardson, TX; Bloomington, IL; Tempe, AZ; Dunwoody, GA

SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

Responsibilities

The Experimentation team identifies the highest-value customer and business opportunities, translates them into thematic testing roadmaps, and partners with data science to ensure experiments generate trustworthy, actionable learning and measurable improvement.

Build a customer-centered growth experimentation portfolio by turning the strongest areas of need and opportunity into thematic testing roadmaps, and make sure every A/B test is designed and run to produce trustworthy, reusable learning. This role brings together conversion rate optimization (CRO), data-driven digital product management, and data-driven experience design to improve how customers move through our digital journeys. It is part of the Digital Growth Engine, a multidisciplinary organization focused on building a stronger learning advantage through trusted data, disciplined experimentation, intelligent decisioning, and scalable technology.

Identify high-value opportunity areas using customer insights, product analytics, clickstream analytics, business priorities, and journey performance.
Organize opportunities into strategic themes and maintain a sequenced experimentation roadmap based on expected value, learning potential, feasibility, and dependencies.
Write clear hypotheses that define the customer problem, intended behavior change, treatment concept, and business rationale for each experiment.
Partner with data science on test design, metrics, sample requirements, guardrails, and interpretation standards.
Coordinate with product, design, engineering, marketing, analytics, and data science to move A/B tests and multivariate experiments from concept to live experience, implemented in ways that preserve measurement integrity.
Drive CRO across key digital journeys, using behavioral data to find friction and prioritize the changes most likely to move conversion and customer outcomes.
Lead portfolio learning reviews that connect individual test results to broader themes and determine what to scale, iterate, or test next.
Identify recurring process, measurement, or data gaps and shape capability improvements that increase experimentation speed and rigor.
Communicate the experimentation pipeline, experimentation velocity, and realized value to senior stakeholders.

How Success Will Be Measured

Quality and value of the opportunity portfolio and strategic recommendations.
Speed at which ambiguous opportunities become testable, measurable decisions.
Share of experiments that launch clean and produce a readable, decision-ready result.
Stakeholder alignment and evidence that learning turns into scaled action.

Leadership & Ways of Working

Champion a test-and-learn culture, treating every experiment, including the ones that don't win, as a chance to build shared knowledge.
Put customer needs and measurable outcomes at the center of decisions.
Work with confident humility: bring expertise, invite challenge, and adapt as evidence changes.
Create clarity in ambiguity and make tradeoffs visible so teams can move with appropriate speed.
Build strong partnerships across business and technology boundaries and share learning broadly.
Operate with high standards for data stewardship, privacy, security, ethics, and enterprise risk management.

Qualifications

Experience in strategy, digital product, analytics, growth, innovation, consulting, or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience planning, running, or scaling A/B testing or growth experimentation programs, with enough statistical fluency to partner with data scientists as a peer.
Experience using Adobe Analytics or similar platforms to analyze clickstream and behavioral data and turn it into testable hypotheses.
Experience with Optimizely or a comparable experimentation platform.
Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, synthesize quantitative and qualitative evidence, and develop clear recommendations.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect customer needs, operational realities, technology capabilities, and enterprise priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready storytelling and decision support.
Ability to lead through influence and coordinate work across multidisciplinary teams in a complex enterprise environment.

Preferred Experience

Experience working in a large, regulated enterprise and navigating privacy, security, legal, risk, and governance requirements.
Experience with data-driven digital product management or experience design, ideally in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Experience with digital customer journeys, growth analytics, personalization, or marketing technology.
Demonstrated success in cross-functional product or pod-based operating models, moving work from insight to implementation.
A bias toward measurable outcomes, reusable capabilities, clear documentation, and continuous learning.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - AI Agency
new_jobs.description:
EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. 

Job Description

WHAT DOES A PROGRAM MANAGER - AI AGENCY DO?

EVERSANA's AI Agency is redefining how life sciences brands plan, create, and activate omnichannel marketing. We operate at the intersection of AI-driven content intelligence and precision omnichannel execution - combining the EVERSANA AI Agency Platform (built on Google Cloud, Gemini, and Vertex AI) with the Orchestrate™ Omnichannel Operating System to deliver measurable commercial impact for pharma and biotech brands.

We are a practitioner culture. That means we don't wait for the industry to catch up - we explore, we build, we break things, and we figure out what AI can actually do in a regulated commercial environment before our clients have to ask. If you are the kind of person who has already built your own workflows in tools like Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or Midjourney- who reads the release notes, experiments on weekends, and shows up to client meetings with something real to show - this role was written for you.

The Program Manager is the operational backbone of client engagements within the AI Agency. This is not a traditional project management role - it is a delivery leadership role that owns the execution of complex, multi-workstream client engagements from kickoff through sustained performance. You will serve as the connective tissue between strategy and execution, ensuring that what we promise in a scope of work translates into delivered value on time, on budget, and with measurable client impact.

You will own the day-to-day orchestration of client work - coordinating Strategic Operators, Creative Operators, Activation Directors, and platform teams to deliver unified outcomes. You will translate client objectives and strategic plans into executable project plans, manage resources and timelines, navigate dependencies and blockers, and ensure every engagement operates with clear accountability and predictable delivery rhythms. This role requires someone who can hold the line on scope, anticipate risks before they become problems, and drive teams toward outcomes without losing sight of the bigger strategic picture.

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Project Planning & Execution

Lead project planning for new client engagements - translating statements of work and strategic briefs into detailed project plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Develop and maintain project timelines, workback schedules, and delivery roadmaps that account for client review cycles, regulatory requirements, platform dependencies, and cross-functional coordination needs.
Own the day-to-day execution of client projects - running daily standups, tracking progress against milestones, identifying blockers, and ensuring teams have what they need to deliver on time.
Establish and maintain project governance structures - including status reporting, risk logs, change request protocols, and client communication cadences - that provide transparency and accountability throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Team Coordination

Serve as the central coordination point for cross-functional delivery teams - including Strategic Operators, Creative Operators, Activation Directors, Client Solutions, platform engineering, and external vendor partners.
Facilitate seamless handoffs between strategy, creative, activation, and platform delivery - ensuring work moves efficiently through the pipeline without rework, delays, or misalignment.
Resolve scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, and priority tensions across multiple concurrent projects - balancing client urgency with team capacity and strategic importance.
Partner with functional leads to ensure the right people are staffed to the right work at the right time - advocating for resource adjustments when project needs shift.

Client Communication & Expectation Management

Serve as a client point of contact for project status, timeline updates, and delivery coordination - building trust through consistent communication, proactive transparency, and reliable follow-through.
Lead project meetings, including kickoffs, check-ins, milestone reviews, and retrospectives - ensuring meetings are productive, action-oriented, and move work forward.
Manage expectations around scope, timelines, and deliverables - clearly communicating what's included, what's not, and what trade-offs exist when priorities shift.
Surface and escalate project risks, scope changes, or timeline impacts to Account Directors early - providing clear options and recommendations for path forward.

Scope & Budget Management

Own project-level budget tracking and resource utilization - monitoring hours against budget, identifying variances, and flagging financial risks before they impact account profitability.
Manage scope boundaries vigilantly - identifying scope creep early, documenting out-of-scope requests, and working with Account Directors to convert scope changes into formal change orders.
Track project profitability at the workstream level - understanding where time is being spent, where efficiency can be gained, and where process improvements can improve margin without compromising quality.
Contribute to scoping and estimation for new work - providing input on level of effort, resource requirements, and delivery timelines based on actual project experience.

Process Improvement & Delivery Excellence

Identify patterns, inefficiencies, and friction points in delivery workflows - and build solutions that make the next project run more smoothly than the last.
Contribute to the development of standardized delivery frameworks, project templates, and process documentation that improve consistency and scalability across the AI Agency.
Lead post-project retrospectives with internal teams - capturing lessons learned, celebrating wins, and converting insights into actionable process improvements.
Partner with operations and enablement teams to evolve project management tools, reporting templates, and delivery best practices that support the AI Agency's growth.

Risk Management & Problem Solving

Anticipate project risks before they materialize - including resource constraints, timeline conflicts, dependency gaps, client availability issues, and technical blockers.
Build contingency plans and mitigation strategies for high-risk projects - ensuring backup options exist when things don't go according to plan.
Navigate ambiguity and make decisions under pressure - knowing when to escalate, when to problem-solve independently, and when to bring teams together to find a path forward. Demonstrate
a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
All other duties as assigned

Qualifications

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Experience

7+ years of experience in project management, delivery leadership, or program management within pharma, life sciences, healthcare marketing, or agency environments, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-workstream client engagements on time and on budget.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams in a client delivery environment - including coordinating creative, strategy, technology, and operations teams to deliver unified outcomes.
Working knowledge of pharma commercialization and marketing operations - including brand strategy, omnichannel campaign development, content production workflows, regulatory review processes, and the compliance requirements that govern pharma marketing.
Experience managing project budgets, tracking resource utilization, and operating with P&L accountability - with an understanding of how delivery efficiency impacts account profitability.
Prior experience working in a fast-paced, early-stage, or high-growth environment where processes are still being built and adaptability is required.

Skills & Capabilities

Delivery operator: You know how to take a complex scope of work and break it into executable plans with clear owners, deadlines, and success criteria - and you know how to keep those plans on track without becoming a bottleneck.
Coordination expert: You can orchestrate multiple teams, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously - ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and everyone knows what's expected of them.
Clear communicator: You can run a client meeting with confidence, deliver a difficult message with clarity, and write a status update that tells people what they need to know without wasting their time.
Scope guardian: You know where advisory ends and execution begins, and you hold that line with clients and internal teams - even when it's uncomfortable.
Problem solver under pressure: You don't panic when things go sideways - you assess the situation, build options, make decisions, and keep the team moving forward.
Process builder: You see patterns in chaos and build lightweight systems that make work more predictable, scalable, and repeatable without adding bureaucracy.

Practitioner Mindset - Non-Negotiable

This is a hard filter, not a cultural nicety. EVERSANA AI Agency is a practitioner culture. We expect every member of this team to be an active explorer of AI and marketing technology - not because it's trendy, but because our clients are paying us to know what's possible before they have to ask.

You are actively using AI tools in your daily work right now - not just for writing emails, but to build workflows, test prompts, generate creative, analyze data, and solve problems you haven't been trained to solve yet.
You follow what's happening in the AI and martech space closely enough to have real opinions - about what works, what doesn't, what's overhyped, and what pharma brands should actually pay attention to.
You experiment before you wait for permission. When a new tool drops, you open it. When a client asks 'can AI do X?', you've already tried.
You can credibly demonstrate what AI-generated content, journey logic, or platform automation looks like to a skeptical CMO - not in theory, but with something you've actually built or run.
You are energized by ambiguity and early-stage environments - you know how to operate in a space that is still being defined, and you help define it.
You hold high standards for clarity and push back when a plan isn't ready to execute.
You default to intellectual honesty with clients, even when the honest answer is 'not yet.'
You care about measurable outcomes, not just smooth engagements.

Additional Information

Patient Minded
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight
I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action
I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Embrace Diversity
I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Grow Talent
I own my development and invest in the developmen

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - IT
new_jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda's designated work from home day is currently Tuesday

Business Technology at Lambda builds and scales the internal systems that power our business. We partner across the company with Finance, GTM, Engineering, and People to implement tools, automate workflows, and ensure data flows securely and accurately. Our scope spans enterprise applications, integrations, data platform and analytics, compliance automation, and all things IT.

We are hiring an IT Technical Program Manager to run the programs that make this portfolio move. You will be the first dedicated program management hire in Business Technology, building our portfolio operating model from the ground up: intake, prioritization, delivery cadence, and change management discipline. Business Technology is delivering a business transformation with roughly ten new enterprise systems this year and a growing integration and data footprint. You will drive cross-functional programs from kickoff through go-live and hypercare, and be the connective tissue between our five pillars: Finance Systems, GTM Systems, Data Platform and Analytics, IT Operations, and People Technology.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who runs programs with rigor, communicates crisply to executives, and holds vendors, partners, and internal teams accountable to dates. You will personally carry our largest programs while building the lightweight structures that make every subsequent program faster.

What You'll Do

Program Delivery: Own end-to-end program management for major system implementations across ERP, procurement, EPM, HRIS, treasury, and identity, coordinating internal teams, implementation partners, and vendors from contract signature through cutover, hypercare, and stabilization.
Roadmap Operations: Run the Business Technology roadmap: maintain the portfolio plan, manage a unified intake and prioritization process, surface dependencies and resource conflicts across pillars, and keep the roadmap honest against team capacity.
Portfolio Governance: Stand up lightweight portfolio governance: stage gates proportionate to program risk, RAID and decision logs, and a portfolio health view that gives the COO and CFO real-time visibility across all five pillars.
SOX Program: Serve as the program manager for Business Technology's SOX ITGC readiness workstream: track control design and remediation milestones across in-scope systems (ERP, procurement, EPM, HRIS, identity), coordinate evidence requests with external auditors and advisors, and report readiness status against the design readiness deadline.
Program Cadence: Build and operate the operating rhythm: weekly status, steering committees, executive readouts, and escalation paths that resolve blockers in days.
Change Management: Design and operationalize formal change management for Business Technology systems, including release calendars, freeze windows, and evidence capture that satisfies ITGC requirements. Partner with our SOX and compliance programs so control design milestones are built into program plans rather than bolted on at the end.
Cutover & Go-Live: Drive cutover and go-live planning: UAT tracking, readiness reviews, hypercare exit criteria, and post-launch retrospectives that actually change how the next program runs.
Vendor & Partner Management: Manage implementation partner and vendor delivery: SOW milestones, burn tracking, change orders, and holding partners to committed outcomes.
Executive Communication: Communicate program status to COO, CFO, and Audit Committee audiences with clarity: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what we are doing about it.
AI-Enabled Program Operations: Continuously improve how Business Technology delivers: templates, playbooks, and tooling (Jira, Google Workspace, AI-assisted status collection and reporting) that reduce program overhead and make delivery faster.

You

Experience: 8+ years in technical program management, with at least 4 years running enterprise application or business systems programs (ERP, CRM, HCM, procurement, EPM, or data platform). You have carried at least two large implementations end to end as the program owner, including cutover and hypercare, ideally with a Big 4 or boutique implementation partner on the other side of the table.
Technical Fluency: Fluent enough in systems architecture, integrations, and data flows to challenge a technical plan, spot a hidden dependency, and know when an estimate is wrong.
Compliance & Controls: Have operated in a SOX or audit-facing environment and understand why change management, access controls, and evidence matter to a program plan. Experience working with external auditors is a strong plus.
Operating Rigor: Run a tight operating cadence by default. Your programs have a single source of truth, current RAID logs, and no surprises in steering.
Builder Orientation: Comfortable defining process from zero. You can take a team that runs on tribal knowledge and give it intake, prioritization, and delivery discipline without adding bureaucracy.
Communication: Communicate exceptionally well upward and sideways. You can compress a messy multi-workstream program into one slide a CFO trusts.
Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and velocity. Priorities shift at a pre-IPO company, and you re-plan without drama.
Attitude: An enthusiastic, go-for-it attitude. When you see a program drifting, you can't help but grab it.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with our stack: NetSuite, Salesforce, Coupa, Workday, Pigment, Workato, Okta, Lumos, BigQuery.
Pre-IPO or IPO readiness program experience, including ITGC remediation or Audit Committee reporting.
Experience with enterprise AI governance: tool approval workflows, AI inventory management, or build-vs-buy frameworks for AI-native applications.
Experience using AI tooling to automate status collection, reporting, and program hygiene.
PMP, PgMP, or SAFe credentials (useful, not required; judgment beats certification).

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
We offer generous cash & equity compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Compensation Range: $278K - $325K

Description

Amazon's Reliability, Maintenance & Engineering (RME) team ensures that our global fulfillment and operations networks run safely, efficiently, and at peak performance. A Program Manager in Central RME will drive initiatives that optimize operational capacity, enhance network performance, and deliver measurable improvements. This role focuses on program execution, addressing operational barriers, implementing standard work practices, and collaborating with RME, non-RME stakeholders, and Operations teams.

Key job responsibilities

Drive cross-functional programs, projects, and initiatives impacting operations; develop solutions collaboratively with RME, non-RME, and Ops stakeholders.
Partner with RME, non-RME, and Ops stakeholders to conduct root cause analysis, eliminate operational barriers, and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across the network.
Maintain and update capacity models including data inputs, methodology documentation, and output validation to support capacity utilization goals.
Use analytics for data-driven decision-making; monitor performance and escalate issues requiring corrective actions.
Create and maintain program artifacts including business requirement documents, initiative plans, and status reports.
Implement standard work practices that improve key business metrics and translate lessons into standards across assigned sites or programs.
Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and management; inform decision-making through clear narratives and data-backed recommendations.
Remove operational barriers through hands-on problem-solving to deliver immediate results.
As a Program Manager, contribute to a culture of operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

A day in the life

Amazon Benefits

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

Paid Time Off (PTO)
401(k) Plan

3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Adapt agile practice to an AI-accelerated pace: streamline planning and coordination so process keeps up with faster development cycles rather than slowing them down.
Manage the backlog with product owners and project leads, ensuring upcoming work is refined, estimated, and aligned to stakeholder needs.
Coach and push the team: raise the team’s agile discipline, hold people to commitments and standards, and foster a collaborative, high-performing delivery environment.

Required:

10+ years of experience in agile delivery, Scrum Master, or agile project/program management roles.

Deep, demonstrated command of Scrum and other agile frameworks (Kanban, SAFe, Lean), and of servant-leadership practice.

Work closely with business and functional analysts to develop functional and technical requirements documents for production-grade data and analytics solutions that drive MetLife’s business forward.

Experience in partner and stakeholder engagement.

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
